primary: tree_delta minus frozen and tree_delta minus local_delta on raw graph support; all direct student controls retained.
gate: Primary graph gain positive in both continuations, pooled paired95 lower bound positive versus frozen and local_delta; distinct-connectivity rate loss at most2pp versus frozen. Fragmentation-only gains are insufficient.
failure_rule: No outcome-based coefficient, support-weight, margin, step or seed sweep. Report negative outcomes; never fit evaluation outputs.
scope: Coordinate-only training regularizer within the existing harmonic-source method. Standard MST and task arithmetic are not novelty claims. No chemical bond labels, inference correction or thermal-law claim.
